name: weft-packages
description: Monorepo catalog — not a public registry. Install via path/git. Order follows the agent stack (docs/ECOSYSTEM.md).

packages.name: mold
packages.summary: Structure & validate agent JSON — JSON Schema, tool_params, tool_spec

packages.name: tokensave
packages.summary: Thrift context, memory, teach → train gold

packages.name: ml
packages.summary: Embeddings, vectors, RAG index, metrics

packages.name: warp
packages.summary: N-dimensional array math — pure Weft, no native deps

packages.name: dataframe
packages.summary: Tabular data wrangling — filter, group, join, pivot, sort

packages.name: embed
packages.summary: Embeddings client + vector store with cosine search

packages.name: experiment
packages.summary: Experiment tracking — log runs, params, metrics, compare

packages.name: metrics
packages.summary: ML metrics — accuracy, F1, precision, recall, confusion matrix

packages.name: http_router
packages.summary: HTTP routing with path params, middleware, groups, CORS

packages.name: template
packages.summary: HTML templating — layouts, partials, loops, conditionals, auto-escaping

packages.name: validate
packages.summary: Data validation for forms and APIs

packages.name: cron
packages.summary: Recurring task scheduler — intervals and daily times

packages.name: retry
packages.summary: Retry with backoff, jitter, and circuit breaker

packages.name: semver
packages.summary: Semantic versioning — parse, compare, bump, ranges

packages.name: color
packages.summary: Terminal color output — ANSI 256 and truecolor

packages.name: cache
packages.summary: In-process LRU cache with TTL

packages.name: jwt
packages.summary: JWT decode, inspect claims, expiry check

packages.name: telecom
packages.summary: IVA, FreeSWITCH ESL, Asterisk ARI, SIP, STT/TTS, routing, queues

packages.name: auth
packages.summary: HMAC, password hashing, token generation, OAuth helpers

packages.name: queue
packages.summary: In-process job queue — workers, retries, dead-letter, priority

packages.name: config
packages.summary: Unified config loader — .env, JSON, YAML, TOML with validation

packages.name: logger
packages.summary: Structured logging — levels, JSON output, context fields, child loggers

packages.name: router
packages.summary: HTTP routing — path params, middleware chains, CORS, rate limiting
